funding.name: Oklahoma's Promise
funding.provider: Oklahoma State Regents for Higher Education
funding.provides: A tuition scholarship for qualifying Oklahoma students to attend Oklahoma colleges, universities and technology centers.
funding.eligibility: Students apply from grades 8 through 11 (page: apply any time from grades 8-11 through Dec.); U.S. citizen or lawfully present; parents' federal adjusted gross income at enrollment not over $60,000 (1-2 dependent children), $70,000 (3-4), or $80,000 (5 or more); special income provisions for children of certified public school teachers; FAFSA required each year of college.
funding.how_to_apply: Start the application online at okhighered.org/OKPROMISE; all documents must be submitted.

funding.name: CareerTech technology center tuition waivers and scholarships
funding.provides: A state listing of tuition waivers and scholarships offered by individual Oklahoma technology centers, such as Caddo Kiowa Technology Center's scholarship for in-district graduates and the Canadian Valley Technology Center Next Step Tuition Waiver.
funding.eligibility: Set by each technology center (for example, in-district graduates of CKTC partner schools; FAFSA required for Canadian Valley).
funding.amount: Up to $2,500 at Caddo Kiowa Technology Center (per the page); other centers vary
funding.how_to_apply: Contact the technology center; Canadian Valley forms are available from counselors after program acceptance.
